## Context / Problem
Seventeen surviving `tests/scripts` files contain 72 audited prose blocks with repetition, history, or obvious narration. Immutable before citations remain at `0033662b5534531d84e39d4a14bf75c8e768e85e`. Several surviving paths changed on main before this grouped edit, so preservation checks compare the exact grouped parent `8ff0355e32c6fb1ba67e4964dc12ba1b4c3e45b0` with final source. The later `origin/main` advance to `10533b1e3f651a60e8cea5691318c108ff1f3396` does not touch them and is irrelevant to the citations. The surviving count is 72: `test_check_config_ownership_heldout.py` has 9 allowlisted blocks, and 441ca94f deleted the 2 planned blocks in `test_binding_lifecycle_grace_seam_clean_heldout.py`.

## Approach and identity
Condense only allowlisted ordinary comments and true leading docstrings. Preserve all runtime strings, prompts, fixtures, decorators, assertions, subprocess arguments, and executable behavior. Stable block IDs are `path::module-docstring`, `path::<qualified-symbol>-docstring`, or `path::<qualified-symbol>::comment(<opening words>)`; use `<module>` as the owner for module-level comments. The line spans below are immutable base citations, never the identity anchor. Adjacent blank-line cleanup is allowed only when attached to an edited block.

Use immutable `0033662b5534531d84e39d4a14bf75c8e768e85e:<path>` blobs for before citations. Compare the exact grouped parent `8ff0355e32c6fb1ba67e4964dc12ba1b4c3e45b0` directly with the final commit for AST, comments, and directives. Parse with `type_comments=True`; remove only allowlisted leading docstrings from `ast.Module`, `ast.ClassDef`, `ast.FunctionDef`, and `ast.AsyncFunctionDef` by their qualified-owner anchors; normalize only `ast.TypeIgnore.lineno`; and require the remaining AST to match. This preserves runtime strings and every executable expression. Tokenize comments and compare every matched directive-bearing physical line plus any shebang byte-for-byte. The grouped commit's changed-path intersection with this leaf must equal its first-class `file_impact` set.

## Scope — immutable base citations
- `conftest.py:1-6,32-35,74-81,111-121,126-131` — preserve import-path necessity, capture behavior, offline network isolation, and pytest fixture ownership.
- `test_alert_dedup.py:1-12,95-102` — preserve lane-specific marker namespaces and accepted string timestamps.
- `test_autodeploy_disk_pressure.py:1-16,291-293,405-407,431-434,439,457-460` — preserve quiescent-tick reclaim, measured before/after logging, streak/reset behavior, persistence-only alerting, and distinct marker tokens.
- `test_autodeploy_fetch_secrets.py:1-17` — preserve secret refresh-before-compose ordering and failure stop.
- `test_autodeploy_health_gate.py:1-15,170-175,246-255` — preserve deadline-above-app budget, pre-rollback stderr capture, and marker-injection protection.
- `test_autodeploy_materialize_certbot.py:1-16` — preserve installer-source triggering and host timer materialization.
- `test_autodeploy_materialize_probe.py:1-14` — preserve observability source-to-host-copy triggering.
- `test_autodeploy_mcp_bluegreen.py:1-18,510-521,650-658,692-698,1622-1631,1640,1646-1648,1662-1672,1700-1713,1714,1715,1721,1729,1735-1738,1752-1764,1997-2004,2144-2153,2333-2341,2477-2490` — preserve atomic cutover, component-local completion/backoff/accounting, safe image retention, handshake/store readiness, liveness anchors, and unconditional live-backend protection.
- `test_autodeploy_review_drain.py:1-20,296-301,346-353,443-464,489-501,637-641,642,643,669-670,687-690,691,692,710-712` — preserve busy and mid-redeploy deferral, bounded episodes, wedged-bot fail-open recovery, signal-unavailable behavior, liveness anchors, and distinct observability markers.
- `test_autodeploy_signals_gerrit_config.py:1-24,41-44` — preserve detect-only/manual-apply classification and operator detail.
- `test_autodeploy_signals_nginx_edge.py:1-22,62-64` — preserve detect-only manual application for the edge template.
- `test_autodeploy_signals_nginx_materializer.py:1-29` — preserve materializer-source detection and manual-apply classification.
- `test_canary_bridge.py:1-30` — preserve immediate drift alerting versus thresholded heartbeat alerting.
- `test_check_adr_numbers.py:1-27` — preserve ADR/marker bijection and duplicate-number detection.
- `test_check_config_ownership_heldout.py:1-12,44-46,84-86,130-132,150-152,177-179,189-191,203-205,246-248` — preserve adversarial detection shapes, category boundaries, and real-tree cleanliness.
- `test_check_config_ownership.py:1-19` — preserve approved ownership seams and fail-closed classification.
- `test_check_config_reads_heldout.py:110-119,243-247,272-277,322-333` — preserve negative string-read fixtures, exact owner attribution, and closed-ticket marker reporting.

Consumers are pytest/CI and `scripts/check_comment_hygiene.py`; `tests/scripts/conftest.py` is discovered by pytest; fixture security is consumed by `tests/unit/test_fixture_env_repr_security.py`; autodeploy environment handling is consumed by `tests/scripts/test_autodeploy_env_repr_security.py`; and `tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py` pins exact workflow/config-read nodes. No target-specific runtime docstring reader was found. Preserve every directive in all 17 surviving files byte-for-byte, especially blue/green pinned lines 1641/1730 and review-drain line 645, which sit inside formerly broad prose ranges; preserve exact shebang absence.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The grouped commit changes exactly the 47-path union; this leaf's 17-path intersection contains only its 72 surviving prose blocks or adjacent blank lines. Parent-to-final normalized AST, runtime, directive, and shebang checks pass.
- [ ] Every edited block is shorter and retains its listed contract and real consumers; repetition, chronology, obvious narration, and ornament are removed rather than moved.
- [ ] A reviewer who did not author the edits posts a 72-row leaf-linked TSV with one row per edited block: stable block ID, immutable-before citation, final-commit citation (or `DELETED` plus surviving neighbor), preserved contract/consumer, `directives_exact`, before/after words, reviewer session, `semantic-preservation`, and `bloat-removal`.
- [ ] Every TSV row records `directives_exact=PASS`, `semantic-preservation=PASS`, and `bloat-removal=PASS`; missing rows, duplicate IDs, bad citations, or any non-PASS result block closure.
- [ ] The focused hermetic checks, `scripts/check_comment_hygiene.py`, path-scoped `git diff --check`, and no-timeout worktree-venv `make verify` all pass. Collection-only checks never execute live Jira mutations.

## Verification
The authoritative executable commands and DD intent are recorded in first-class `verify_commands`. Do not replace `make verify` with `make lint`, and do not put a timeout around it.

## Current base correction
The grouped change starts at fresh origin/main `8ff0355e32c6fb1ba67e4964dc12ba1b4c3e45b0` and includes 2 disjoint leaves. The deleted binding-lifecycle file has no current source to edit and is removed from file_impact. Immutable before citations remain historical; current behavior is checked against the grouped parent.
